title: Phrasal verbs (work and everyday)
en:
A phrasal verb = verb + particle (up, off, on, out…), often with a new meaning: look for (искать), find out (узнать), put off (отложить), call back (перезвонить), set up (создать, организовать), fill in (заполнить), turn on / off, give up (бросить), look into (изучить вопрос), carry out (провести, выполнить).

With most separable verbs, a noun can go before or after the particle, but a pronoun goes in the middle: Turn off the light / Turn the light off / Turn it off (not turn off it).
ru: Фразовые глаголы: глагол + частица с новым значением (look for — искать, find out — узнать, put off — отложить, call back — перезвонить, set up — организовать, fill in — заполнить, carry out — провести, look into — разобраться). Местоимение ставится между глаголом и частицей: turn it off.

boss.situation: Write a short message rescheduling a meeting. Use at least 4 phrasal verbs: put off, call back, look into, find out, set up.
samples: Hi Dana, we need to put off tomorrow's meeting.
I'm still looking into the problem with the invoices.
I'll find out when the director is free.
Can you set up a new call for Thursday?
If you have questions, I'll call you back after lunch.
